SEARCH
Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class XKB

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.XKB
public class XKB extends Object
ISO 9995-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_XKB_KEYS section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0xfe.
